title: Head Up Display (HUD) Module
introduction:
The illustrations locate the head up display module in the narrow strip at the top of the instrument panel, near the windshield and above the instrument cluster. The installed view marks the tab-release point; the raised view exposes the electrical connector underneath.

I think of the tab as a cupboard latch: release what holds the module before lifting it. A non-marring tool is specified for that release. The sequence below covers removal and refitting; it supplies no electrical diagnosis or operational-test procedure.

items.name: Non-marring tool
items.detail: Use a non-marring tool to release the retaining tab at the illustrated point.

items.name: Prevent an unexpected start
items.detail: Before service, disable remote start, if equipped, through the Central Display: Vehicle settings > Remote Start Setup. Otherwise, the vehicle could be remotely started at any time, causing personal injury or death. Remove the key from the vehicle to prevent another person starting the engine during service; an accidental start can cause serious personal injury.

items.name: Personal protection
items.detail: Wear eye and ear protection during vehicle service. Wear protective gloves when handling components with pointed or sharp edges. Ignoring these precautions may result in serious personal injury.

edits.text: Use a non-marring tool at the illustrated release point to free the retaining tab, then raise the HUD from its seated position.
edits.why: Releasing the tab frees the module's retention. Raising it then provides access to the connector shown in the next illustration.

edits.text: With the HUD raised, disconnect the electrical connector shown underneath it, then remove the HUD.
edits.why: The raised-view illustration identifies the wiring connection that still joins the module to the vehicle after it has been lifted from its seat.

edits.text: Reverse the removal order: reconnect the electrical connector, then lower the module into its opening and seat it so the retaining tab engages.
edits.why: The connector is accessible while the module is raised. Seating the module restores the tab's retention and completes the supplied installation sequence.
